quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: Inference flow: a discrete dynamical system along depth
相图上的量或现象: 推理流：沿深度演化的离散动力系统
description in the literature: Residual networks are discretizations of ordinary differential equations
文献中的描述: 残差网络是常微分方程的离散化
sources: E 2017; Haber & Ruthotto 2017; Chen et al. 2018; Lu et al. 2019

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: d_C: participation ratio of the within-document covariance
相图上的量或现象: d_C：文档内协方差的参与比
description in the literature: Participation ratio; effective rank and intrinsic dimension measure dimensionality in other ways
文献中的描述: 参与比；有效秩和内在维数以其他方式度量维数
sources: Roy & Vetterli 2007; Facco et al. 2017; Ansuini et al. 2019

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: u: ratio of the between-document offset to the within-document variation
相图上的量或现象: u：文档间偏移与文档内变化之比
description in the literature: Ratio of between-class to within-class scatter
文献中的描述: 类间散布与类内散布之比

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: E = u/(√d_C + u): approximately the average cosine similarity between two tokens of the same document; document identification accuracy rises with it
相图上的量或现象: E = u/(√d_C + u)：近似为同一文档两个 token 表示的平均余弦相似度；文档识别准确率随它上升

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: δ: offset of the document mean relative to the reference
相图上的量或现象: δ：文档均值相对参照的偏移
description in the literature: Difference-of-means directions: linear directions of concepts such as truth and gender
文献中的描述: 均值差方向：真假、性别等概念的线性方向

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: The mean shared by all documents, removed in δ
相图上的量或现象: 所有文档共有的均值，在 δ 中扣除
description in the literature: Anisotropy: high cosine similarity between representations in upper layers
文献中的描述: 各向异性：高层表示之间余弦相似度高
sources: Ethayarajh 2019; Gao et al. 2019; Mu & Viswanath 2018

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: Two phases on the (u, d_C) plane: trained models enter and stay in the working phase, untrained networks drift; at P* the effective force is a stable node for trained models and a saddle for untrained ones; training is a transition between the two phases
相图上的量或现象: (u, d_C) 平面上的两个相：训练后模型进入并停在工作相，未训练网络漂移；有效力在 P* 处对训练后模型是稳定结点、对未训练网络是鞍点；训练是两相之间的转变
description in the literature: A phase diagram for training and inference in language models
文献中的描述: 语言模型训练与推理的相图

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: Inference flows of trained models: u rises with depth, and d_C first rises slightly and then falls slightly
相图上的量或现象: 训练后模型的推理流：u 随深度上升，d_C 先略升后略降
description in the literature: Linear-probe accuracy rises with depth; intrinsic dimension first rises and then falls with depth
文献中的描述: 线性探针准确率随深度上升；内在维数随深度先升后降
sources: Alain & Bengio 2017; Ansuini et al. 2019; Valeriani et al. 2023; Cheng et al. 2025

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: Inference flows of trained models reside in the working phase
相图上的量或现象: 训练后模型的推理流驻留在工作相
description in the literature: Layer redundancy: some intermediate and deep layers can be deleted or reordered with little change in performance
文献中的描述: 深层冗余：部分中间层和深层可以删去或换序，而性能变化很小
sources: Veit et al. 2016; Gromov et al. 2025; Men et al. 2025; Lad et al. 2024

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: Inference flows of untrained runs go to the collapse region or the noise region depending on the initialization scale
相图上的量或现象: 未训练网络的推理流随初始化尺度去往坍缩区或噪声区
description in the literature: Random Transformers exhibit rank collapse or entropy collapse depending on the initialization scale of attention; signal propagation in random deep networks lies in an ordered or a chaotic phase depending on the initialization scale; networks initialized near the boundary between the two are most easily trained
文献中的描述: 随机 Transformer 随注意力的初始化尺度出现秩坍缩或熵坍缩；随机深层网络中的信号传播随初始化尺度处在有序相或混沌相；在两者分界附近初始化的网络最易训练
sources: Dong et al. 2021; Noci et al. 2022; Giorlandino & Goldt 2026; Poole et al. 2016; Schoenholz et al. 2017; Bahri et al. 2020
bibtex keys: dong2021attention; noci2022signal; giorlandino2026two; poole2016exponential; schoenholz2017deep; bahri2020statistical

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: The u → ∞ limit of the drifting phase
相图上的量或现象: 漂移相的 u → ∞ 极限
description in the literature: Rank collapse; merging of token representations into a single cluster in self-attention dynamics; neural collapse with documents as classes
文献中的描述: 秩坍缩；自注意力动力学中 token 表示合并为一簇；以文档为类的神经坍缩
sources: Dong et al. 2021; Noci et al. 2022; Geshkovski et al. 2023; Geshkovski et al. 2025; Papyan et al. 2020

quantity or phenomenon on the phase diag: During training, the inference flow enters the working phase from the drifting phase; d_C first drops sharply, then recovers, and falls back late in training, and E rises early
相图上的量或现象: 训练中，推理流从漂移相进入工作相；d_C 先骤降、后恢复、后期回落，E 很早上升
description in the literature: During pretraining, the effective rank of representations first drops sharply, then recovers, and later decreases as the representations are compressed toward a few principal directions; during long loss plateaus, the hidden states of different tokens are nearly parallel; probe accuracy is established early in pretraining
文献中的描述: 预训练中，表示的有效秩先骤降、后恢复，之后随表示被压缩到少数主方向而下降；在长的损失平台期，不同 token 的隐藏状态几乎平行；探针准确率在预训练早期就已建立
sources: Li et al. 2025; Gopalani & Hu 2025; Liu et al. 2021
